verdict.rationale: Mercury's official MCP server lets AI assistants work with accounts, transactions, recipients and cards using natural-language questions such as "What's my balance today?" and "Graph my last 6 months of transactions". The API page also advertises natural-language queries over balances and history, and official agent skills drive the Mercury CLI. Missing for 10: clear evidence that write operations (payments, invoices, card changes) work through natural-language commands rather than only read queries, a built-in natural-language interface that doesn't need an external AI client, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
